items.title: 56799_Red Norvo oral history interview
items.q: Benny Carter is opening uptown -- at Small's Paradise and we went up -- Mildred and I went up for the opening and he brought Teddy Wilson in from Chicago

ctx.x: We'll come back to him again, because we've got time, we want to.
But you know, later so many guys -- well Benny Carter used to tell me, gosh Frank was really his idol --
